questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Microwave Transmission Lines, Characteristic Impedance, Reflection Coefficient & VSWR
questions.text: Derive the Transmission Line Equations for voltage $V(z)$ and current $I(z)$ in terms of propagation constant $\gamma = \alpha + j\beta$ and characteristic impedance $Z_0 = \sqrt{\frac{R + j\omega L}{G + j\omega C}}$. Define Voltage Standing Wave Ratio ($VSWR = \frac{1 + |\Gamma|}{1 - |\Gamma|}$) and Reflection Coefficient $\Gamma = \frac{Z_L - Z_0}{Z_L + Z_0}$.

Explain the construction and properties of the Smith Chart (Constant resistance circles and constant reactance arcs). Using a Smith Chart, design a Single-Stub Shunt matching network to match an antenna load impedance $Z_L = 100 + j80\,\Omega$ to a $50\,\Omega$ lossless transmission line. Find the distance $d$ from the load and the length $l$ of an open/shorted stub.
Explain Double-Stub Impedance Matching on a transmission line using a Smith Chart. Explain why double-stub matching is preferred over single-stub matching in tunable RF circuits.

Derive the wave equations for TE and TM modes in a Rectangular Waveguide of dimensions $a \times b$ ($a > b$). Derive expressions for Cutoff Frequency ($f_c = \frac{c}{2}\sqrt{(m/a)^2 + (n/b)^2}$), Guide Wavelength ($\lambda_g = \frac{\lambda_0}{\sqrt{1 - (f_c/f)^2}}$), Phase Velocity ($v_p = \frac{c}{\sqrt{1 - (f_c/f)^2}}$), and Wave Impedance ($Z_{TE} = \frac{\eta}{\sqrt{1 - (f_c/f)^2}}$). Why can TEM waves not propagate inside a hollow waveguide?

Explain the Dominant Mode ($TE_{10}$) in a rectangular waveguide. An air-filled rectangular waveguide with dimensions $a = 2.286\,\text{cm}$ and $b = 1.016\,\text{cm}$ (X-band) operates at $10\,\text{GHz}$. Calculate: (a) Cutoff wavelength $\lambda_c$, (b) Guide wavelength $\lambda_g$, (c) Phase velocity $v_p$, (d) Group velocity $v_g$ ($v_p \cdot v_g = c^2$), and (e) Wave impedance $Z_{TE}$.

Define Scattering Parameters (S-Parameters) for an $N$-port microwave junction ($b = S a$). State and prove the properties of S-matrix: (a) Symmetry for reciprocal network ($[S]^T = [S]$), and (b) Unitary property for lossless junction ($[S]^*[S]^T = [I]$). Why are H-parameters and Z-parameters difficult to measure at microwave frequencies?

Explain the operation and derive the S-Matrix for: (a) E-Plane Tee (Series Tee), (b) H-Plane Tee (Shunt Tee), and (c) Magic Tee (Hybrid Tee $[S]_{4\times 4}$). Explain applications of Magic Tee as an RF mixer, duplexer, and impedance bridge.

Explain Directional Couplers: Coupling Factor ($C = 10\log_{10}(P_1/P_3)$), Directivity ($D = 10\log_{10}(P_3/P_4)$), and Isolation ($I = 10\log_{10}(P_1/P_4)$). Explain Ferrite isolators, circulators, and attenuators.

Explain the Gunn Effect and Ridley-Watkins-Hilsum (RWH) Transferred-Electron Mechanism in GaAs diode. Draw the velocity-field ($v-E$) characteristic showing negative differential resistance region and explain Gunn domain formation.

Explain Avalanche Transit-Time devices: IMPATT (Impact Ionization Avalanche Transit-Time) Diode and TRAPATT Diode. Explain Read diode structure ($p^+-n-i-n^+$), phase delay mechanism between RF voltage and avalanche current ($90^\circ + 90^\circ = 180^\circ$), and output power/efficiency.

Explain Two-Cavity Klystron Amplifier: Velocity Modulation process, Applegate diagram, bunching parameter ($	heta$), drift space, and cavity interaction. Derive the expression for RF current and electronic efficiency.
Explain Reflex Klystron Oscillator: Repeller voltage ($V_r$), velocity modulation, round-trip electron bunching transit time ($T = (n + 3/4)T_0$), mode curves, and electronic tuning range.

Explain Cylindrical Cavity Magnetron (Crossed-field tube): Hull Cut-off Magnetic Field ($B_c = \sqrt{\frac{8 m V_0}{e b^2 (1 - a^2/b^2)^2}}$), Hartree Resonant Anode Voltage, $\pi$-mode oscillations, and strapping to avoid mode jumping.
Explain Traveling Wave Tube (TWT) Amplifier: Slow-Wave Structure (Helical waveguide), wave-electron beam synchronization ($v_e \approx v_p$), amplification mechanism, and comparison with Klystrons.

Explain Quarter-Wave Transformer ($Z_{in} = \frac{Z_0^2}{Z_L}$) for matching a real load $R_L$ to transmission line $Z_0$. Explain Multi-section binomial and Chebyshev impedance matching transformers.
Explain Rectangular and Cylindrical Cavity Resonators. Derive the Resonant Frequency ($f_r$) and Quality Factor ($Q$) of a rectangular cavity resonator operating in $TE_{101}$ mode.

Explain PIN Diode (High resistivity intrinsic layer $I$) operation as an RF switch, limiter, and variable attenuator. Explain Varactor Diode and its voltage-variable junction capacitance ($C_j(V) = \frac{C_0}{(1 - V/V_0)^n}$) in parametric amplifiers.
